subject.title: feat: validate required run artifacts against a schema (`--require-artifact-schema`)

question: Should Crabbox adopt `--require-artifact-schema` as a permanent core CLI surface using this custom fail-closed JSON Schema subset?
rationale: The choice creates a long-lived schema language, error contract, evidence format, size limit, and provider-support boundary that implementation correctness alone cannot settle.

options.title: Adopt the bounded subset
options.body: Approve the proposed opt-in contract after the parser defect is fixed and real SSH-backed proof is supplied.

options.title: Require a standard validator
options.body: Accept schema validation only through a maintained standards-compatible implementation rather than a Crabbox-specific dialect.

options.title: Keep validation repository-owned
options.body: Retain the current model where each repository command validates its own evidence before Crabbox checks artifact existence.

recommendation.title: Adopt the bounded subset
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed opt-in contract after the parser defect is fixed and real SSH-backed proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this person most closely to the existing run-artifact behavior and its user-facing contract.
